summary: Diff includes updates to DailyReportDialog rendering/summary logic, adds/extends a manual QA checklist entry for multi-day import + scrolling, and adds CSS for a daily report scroll container plus a number of unrelated UI/theme/Android-Chrome compatibility changes. Backend daily aggregation correctness is not verifiable from the truncated backend diff.

missing_requirements.requirement: Fix the Daily Report so it reliably returns and displays one aggregated record per calendar day (within the selected date range) for days that have pickups, and it does not collapse multiple days into a single displayed day.
missing_requirements.reason: The backend portion of the fix (reliably returning one aggregated record per calendar day) cannot be confirmed from the provided diff because backend/main.mo is truncated before any daily report aggregation logic is shown. On the frontend, days are filtered by `calculatedTotal > 0`, which may exclude a day that has pickups but totals to 0 (e.g., zero-fare/zero-tip records), which is not equivalent to 'days that have pickups'.
evidence: backend/main.mo (truncated; daily report implementation not shown)

missing_requirements.requirement: Ensure the Daily Report dialog supports scrolling so all daily breakdown cards and the final summary are reachable on both desktop and mobile.
missing_requirements.reason: CSS for a scroll container (`.daily-report-scroll`) is added, and the dialog content has a max height, but the truncated DailyReportDialog.tsx snippet does not show the actual scrollable wrapper (e.g., an element with `overflow-y-auto` / applying `.daily-report-scroll`). Therefore, functional scrolling within the dialog cannot be verified from the provided excerpt.
